Class BlueJCompileListener

java.lang.Object
tt.uwi.collection.BlueJCompileListener
All Implemented Interfaces:
bluej.extensions2.event.CompileListener
public class BlueJCompileListener extends Object implements bluej.extensions2.event.CompileListener
Receives BlueJ compilation events and publishes corresponding telemetry. Optional callbacks keep class and method inventories synchronized after compilation events.
